title: Fixture Accounts API playbook
purpose: Check that a client can create accounts through the accounts API.
actors: API tester with an HTTP client

scenarios.title: Create account
scenarios.goal: A client creates an account with a name.
steps: Send `POST /accounts` with JSON body `{"name": "Playbook Tester"}` (operation **Create account**).
expected: The body has an `id` and `name` is `Playbook Tester`.
cleanup: Restart the fixture API to clear in-memory accounts.

scenarios.title: Reject an empty name
scenarios.goal: The API refuses an account without a name.
